entries.text: The MCP conformance script's Inspector pin check now accepts both the object and the one-element array that npm view prints, so it passes on npm 10 and npm 12.

The package smoke check (CI package-smoke and make test-package) now installs the built wheel with the duckdb extra in a clean environment and runs the README's first benchmark command, benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01.
